decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The store building situated at the rear of the garden, would, by reason of its size,   position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring  properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the outlook and   amenities of adjoining occupiers and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development) and H3.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Residential House Extension Guidelines.  


2/  The store building situated at the rear of the garden, would, by reason of its size,   position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring  properties,  not serve to maintain the character of the Isleworth Riverside Conservation Area and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.2 (Conservation Areas)  of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance Conservation Areas.
description: Retention of a garden shed to existing rear garden of dwellinghouse.
